subject: Zoning Ordinance Updates
overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee reviewed proposed updates to Medford's zoning code, including definitions, the consolidated table of uses, municipal site plan review rules, and the digital GIS zoning map. The committee voted to report all four zoning items out to the full City Council for referral to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Table of Uses and Zoning Definitions
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed updates to zoning definitions and the consolidated table of uses and parking regulations, approving them for referral to the City Council with additional footnotes for parking exemptions.

items.title: Digital GIS Zoning Map Codification
items.summary: Staff presented the digitized official GIS zoning map, which formalizes existing zoning boundaries without making any substantive zoning changes, and the committee voted to report it out.

items.title: Municipal Site Plan Review Exemption
items.summary: The committee approved an amendment exempting municipal projects from standard zoning variance requirements while keeping major municipal projects subject to site plan review standards.

items.title: Committee Schedule and Upcoming Topics
items.summary: The committee outlined plans to review non-municipal site plan review, Climate Action and Adaptation Plan integration, and mapping analysis during meetings scheduled for June 12 and June 26.
